completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed three CI failure modes: added repository guards to lake-update.yml, restored --wfail to CI flags with set_option warn.sorry false on 4 Bimodal files with intentional sorry stubs, removed 2 unused simp arguments from GNBA.lean, and expanded pre-pr-check.sh to cover Bimodal modules. All modified modules pass lake build --wfail --iofail.

memory_candidates.content: In Lean 4 (v4.31.0+), the option to suppress the 'declaration uses sorry' warning is `warn.sorry`, not `linter.sorry`. Use `set_option warn.sorry false in` before a declaration or `set_option warn.sorry false` at section scope. The option is declared in Lean.AddDecl. The `linter.sorry` name does not exist.
